open_issues: lakelevelnow.com has no river pages; more links go to the home page or the Texas/California state lake pages by gauge state.

USGS keyless rate limit applies per IP; Cloudflare egress IPs are shared. Edge cache (300 s readings, 1 day site data) limits calls; 429 returns an honest UpstreamError (tested). If 429s appear in production, an api.data.gov key would need owner sign-up (OWNER UNLOCK, https://api.data.gov/signup/).
NWS stage vs USGS gage height assumed same datum for feet-below-flood-stage; README tells users to check the NWS gauge page for safety decisions.
Name search uses CQL CASEI LIKE per word; abbreviations in USGS names (for example "Colorado Rv") can miss "river" queries, which is why river/creek are dropped as stop words.
